title: Mandatory Privacy Policy Clauses — DPDP Act 2023 + Rules 2025 + IT Act

clauses.section_title: Identity & Contact Information of Data Fiduciary
clauses.mandatory_clause: Name and legal identity of the Data Fiduciary (company name, registration details)
clauses.scanner_check: Check if company/organization name is mentioned in privacy policy
clauses.sample_language: [Company Name] ('we', 'our', 'us') is the Data Fiduciary responsible for processing your personal data under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

clauses.section_title: Identity & Contact Information of Data Fiduciary
clauses.mandatory_clause: Contact details of the Data Fiduciary — email, phone, address
clauses.scanner_check: Check for email address, phone number, or physical address in privacy/contact section
clauses.sample_language: For questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at: [Email] | [Phone] | [Address]

clauses.section_title: Identity & Contact Information of Data Fiduciary
clauses.mandatory_clause: Name and contact details of Data Protection Officer (if SDF) or Grievance Officer
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'grievance officer', 'DPO', 'data protection officer' with name and contact details
clauses.sample_language: Grievance Officer: [Name], Email: [email], Phone: [phone]. You may contact our Grievance Officer for any concerns regarding your personal data.

clauses.section_title: Identity & Contact Information of Data Fiduciary
clauses.mandatory_clause: Information on how to file a complaint with the Data Protection Board of India
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'Data Protection Board', 'DPB', 'complaint', 'Board' with reference to filing process
clauses.sample_language: If you are not satisfied with our response, you have the right to file a complaint with the Data Protection Board of India as per Section 13 of the DPDP Act, 2023.

clauses.mandatory_clause: ITEMISED list of all categories of personal data collected (name, email, phone, address, payment info, etc.)
clauses.scanner_check: Check for specific data types listed — 'name', 'email', 'phone', 'address', 'payment', 'location', etc.
clauses.sample_language: We collect the following personal data: (a) Name, (b) Email address, (c) Phone number, (d) Postal address, (e) Payment information, (f) Device information, (g) Usage data, (h) [Add specific categories].

clauses.mandatory_clause: How personal data is collected — forms, cookies, third-party sources, automatic collection
clauses.scanner_check: Check for descriptions of collection methods — 'forms', 'cookies', 'automatically', 'third party'
clauses.sample_language: We collect your personal data through: (a) Forms you fill on our website/app, (b) Cookies and tracking technologies, (c) Third-party services, (d) Automatic collection when you use our platform.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Specific disclosure if children's data (under 18) is collected, including parental consent mechanism
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'children', 'minor', 'under 18', 'parental consent', 'age verification'
clauses.sample_language: We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 18 years of age without verifiable parental consent. If we become aware that we have collected data from a child without parental consent, we will delete it immediately.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Disclosure if sensitive categories are processed — health, financial, biometric, sexual orientation, political opinion
clauses.dpdp_source: IT Act SPDI Rules (still applicable for sensitive data)
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'sensitive', 'health', 'financial', 'biometric', 'medical'
clauses.sample_language: We may process the following categories of sensitive personal data: [health records / financial data / biometric data]. Such data is processed with additional safeguards as required by law.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Statement that only necessary data is collected for the specified purpose
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'necessary', 'minimum', 'only collect', 'limited to', 'required for'
clauses.sample_language: We collect only the personal data that is necessary for the purposes specified in this policy. We do not collect data 'just in case' or for unspecified future use.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Specific, clearly stated purposes for which each type of personal data is processed
clauses.scanner_check: Check for purpose statements linked to data types — 'we use your [data] for [purpose]'
clauses.sample_language: We process your personal data for the following specific purposes: (a) Email — to send account verification and service communications, (b) Phone number — to enable two-factor authentication, (c) Address — to deliver products, (d) Payment info — to process transactions.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Purpose must describe the goods, services, or uses enabled by the processing
clauses.scanner_check: Check if purposes are linked to specific services/products, not vague statements
clauses.sample_language: Each purpose of processing is directly linked to the goods and services we provide: [describe specific services enabled by data processing].

clauses.mandatory_clause: Statement that data will not be used for purposes beyond what was consented to
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'will not use for other purposes', 'limited to', 'only for the stated purpose'
clauses.sample_language: We will not process your personal data for any purpose other than those specified in this notice at the time of collection, unless we obtain your separate consent.

clauses.mandatory_clause: If processing without consent under Section 7, clearly state which legitimate use applies
clauses.scanner_check: Check for references to 'legitimate use', 'Section 7', 'without consent', 'employment', 'legal obligation'
clauses.sample_language: In certain cases, we may process your personal data without explicit consent where permitted under Section 7 of the DPDP Act, including: (a) performance of employment obligations, (b) compliance with legal requirements, (c) medical emergencies.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Clear statement that processing is based on free, specific, informed, unconditional consent
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'consent', 'free', 'specific', 'informed', 'unconditional'
clauses.sample_language: We process your personal data based on your free, specific, informed, and unconditional consent as required under Section 6 of the DPDP Act, 2023.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Clear statement of right to withdraw consent at any time
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'withdraw consent', 'revoke consent', 'right to withdraw'
clauses.sample_language: You have the right to withdraw your consent at any time. Withdrawal of consent shall be as easy as giving consent.

clauses.mandatory_clause: SPECIFIC communication link or method to withdraw consent — must be as easy as giving consent
clauses.scanner_check: Check for clickable link, email, or clear steps for consent withdrawal
clauses.sample_language: To withdraw your consent: [Click here / Go to Settings > Privacy > Withdraw Consent / Email us at privacy@company.com]. The process is designed to be as simple as the original consent.

clauses.mandatory_clause: What happens when consent is withdrawn — service limitations, data deletion timeline
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'consequences', 'if you withdraw', 'will stop processing', 'delete your data'
clauses.sample_language: If you withdraw your consent: (a) We will stop processing your personal data for the specified purpose, (b) We will erase your data unless retention is required by law, (c) Certain services may no longer be available to you.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Consent must be purpose-specific — separate consent for each distinct purpose, no bundling
clauses.scanner_check: Check if consent is separated by purpose, not a single 'I agree to everything' checkbox
clauses.sample_language: We request your consent separately for each purpose: (a) Service delivery [Required], (b) Marketing communications [Optional], (c) Analytics [Optional]. You may consent to some purposes and not others.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Right to obtain summary of personal data and processing activities
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'right to access', 'request your data', 'summary of data', 'access information'
clauses.sample_language: You have the right to request: (a) A summary of all personal data we hold about you, (b) Details of our processing activities, (c) The identities of all entities we have shared your data with.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Right to request correction of inaccurate or misleading personal data
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'right to correct', 'correction', 'update your data', 'rectification'
clauses.sample_language: You have the right to request correction of any inaccurate, incomplete, or misleading personal data we hold about you.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Right to request deletion of personal data
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'right to erasure', 'right to delete', 'deletion', 'erase your data'
clauses.sample_language: You have the right to request erasure of your personal data, subject to any legal retention obligations.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Right to grievance redressal — process, officer, timeline
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'grievance', 'complaint', 'grievance redressal', 'response time'
clauses.sample_language: If you have a grievance regarding our processing of your personal data, you may contact our Grievance Officer at [contact]. We will respond within [X] days.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Right to nominate a person to exercise rights in case of death or incapacity
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'nominate', 'nomination', 'death', 'incapacity'
clauses.sample_language: You have the right to nominate another individual who may exercise your rights under this Act in the event of your death or incapacity.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Specific method/link for exercising rights — steps, verification, timeline
clauses.scanner_check: Check for link/email/form for submitting data requests + verification requirements + response timeline
clauses.sample_language: To exercise any of your rights, please [submit a request at link / email privacy@company.com / visit Settings > Your Data]. We will verify your identity and respond within [X] days.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Identities of all Data Processors who process data on behalf of the Fiduciary
clauses.scanner_check: Check for list of third parties, processors, vendors, partners who receive data
clauses.sample_language: We share your personal data with the following Data Processors: (a) [Cloud provider — hosting], (b) [Payment gateway — payment processing], (c) [Analytics tool — usage analysis], (d) [Email service — communications].

clauses.mandatory_clause: Purpose for which data is shared with each third party
clauses.scanner_check: Check if each third-party disclosure includes the reason for sharing
clauses.sample_language: Each third-party Data Processor receives only the data necessary for their specific function and is contractually bound to process it solely for the purpose specified.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Statement that processors are bound by contracts with equivalent security safeguards
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'contract', 'agreement', 'bound by', 'data processing agreement'
clauses.sample_language: All Data Processors engaged by us are bound by Data Processing Agreements that mandate equivalent security safeguards including encryption, access controls, and breach notification obligations.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Disclosure if personal data is transferred outside India + legal basis
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'transfer outside India', 'cross-border', 'international transfer', 'stored outside'
clauses.sample_language: Your personal data may be transferred to and processed in countries outside India: [list countries/regions]. Such transfers are made in compliance with Section 16 of the DPDP Act and are not made to countries restricted by the Central Government.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Description of reasonable security safeguards implemented — encryption, access controls, etc.
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'encryption', 'security', 'safeguards', 'access controls', 'protection'
clauses.sample_language: We implement reasonable security safeguards to protect your personal data, including: (a) Encryption at rest and in transit, (b) Role-based access controls, (c) Regular security audits, (d) Logging and monitoring of data access, (e) Business continuity measures.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Commitment to notify Data Principals and DPB of any personal data breach
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'breach', 'notify', 'notification', 'data breach', 'incident'
clauses.sample_language: In the event of a personal data breach, we will: (a) Notify the Data Protection Board of India without delay and submit a detailed report within 72 hours, (b) Notify affected Data Principals without delay with details of the breach, its consequences, and mitigation measures.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Breach notification must include: nature, consequences, mitigation steps, contact for follow-up
clauses.scanner_check: Check if breach notification section mentions nature/consequences/mitigation/contact
clauses.sample_language: Our breach notification to you will include: (a) Nature of the breach, (b) Potential consequences, (c) Steps we have taken to mitigate the breach, (d) Contact details for further information.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Implied commitment to transparency — no suppression of breach information
clauses.scanner_check: Check for transparency commitments around breach reporting
clauses.sample_language: We are committed to transparency. We will never suppress or delay notification of a personal data breach. Failure to report carries penalties up to ₹200 Crore under the DPDP Act.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Specific retention periods for each category of personal data + legal basis for retention
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'retention', 'how long', 'keep your data', 'storage period', 'delete after'
clauses.sample_language: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary for the specified purpose: (a) Account data — duration of account + 1 year, (b) Transaction data — as required by tax law (currently 7 years), (c) Communication data — 1 year after last interaction.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Minimum 1-year retention of data + logs for security/investigation purposes
clauses.scanner_check: Check for '1 year', 'one year', 'minimum retention', 'log retention'
clauses.sample_language: We retain system logs, processing records, and associated traffic data for a minimum period of one year for detection, investigation, and remediation of security incidents as required by DPDP Rules.

clauses.mandatory_clause: When data will be erased — purpose served, consent withdrawn, account deleted
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'erase', 'delete', 'remove', triggers for deletion
clauses.sample_language: Your personal data will be erased when: (a) The specified purpose is no longer served, (b) You withdraw your consent, (c) You request deletion, (d) Your account is inactive beyond the prescribed period — unless retention is required by law.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Statement that Data Processors will also be instructed to erase data
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'processors will delete', 'instruct processors to erase'
clauses.sample_language: Upon erasure, we will instruct all Data Processors to whom your data was shared to delete your personal data from their systems as well.

clauses.mandatory_clause: What cookies and tracking technologies are used + their purpose
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'cookies', 'tracking', 'analytics', 'pixel', 'beacon'
clauses.sample_language: We use the following cookies and tracking technologies: (a) Essential cookies — required for website functionality, (b) Analytics cookies — [Google Analytics / Mixpanel] to understand usage patterns, (c) Marketing cookies — [specify] for advertising purposes.

clauses.mandatory_clause: List of all third-party tracking services with their purpose
clauses.scanner_check: Check if all third-party trackers (GA, FB Pixel, etc.) are listed by name
clauses.sample_language: The following third-party services may collect data through our platform: (a) Google Analytics — usage analytics, (b) [Facebook Pixel — ad conversion tracking], (c) [Hotjar — user behavior analysis]. Each operates under their own privacy policy.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Consent mechanism for non-essential cookies — must be opt-in, not opt-out
clauses.scanner_check: Check for cookie consent banner/mechanism that allows user to accept/reject non-essential cookies
clauses.sample_language: Non-essential cookies are only placed with your explicit consent. You may manage your cookie preferences at any time via [Cookie Settings link]. Essential cookies required for basic functionality do not require consent.

clauses.mandatory_clause: Privacy notice must be in clear, plain language — not legal jargon
clauses.scanner_check: Check readability — presence of complex legal terms without explanation, sentence length
clauses.sample_language: [Meta-requirement: The entire privacy policy must be written in clear, plain language that an average person can understand without legal training.]

clauses.mandatory_clause: Available in English + any of the 22 Eighth Schedule languages
clauses.scanner_check: Check for language toggle or availability in Hindi/regional languages
clauses.sample_language: This Privacy Policy is available in English and [Hindi / other scheduled languages]. [Language toggle link]

clauses.mandatory_clause: Privacy notice must be independent and understandable on its own — NOT buried in Terms & Conditions
clauses.scanner_check: Check if privacy notice is a separate page/section, not embedded within T&C
clauses.sample_language: [Meta-requirement: This privacy policy must be presented as a standalone document, separate from Terms of Service, and independently accessible.]

clauses.mandatory_clause: Date the privacy policy was last updated / became effective
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'last updated', 'effective date', date at top or bottom of policy
clauses.sample_language: Last Updated: [Date]. This Privacy Policy is effective as of [Date].

clauses.mandatory_clause: How users will be notified of changes to the privacy policy
clauses.scanner_check: Check for 'notify you of changes', 'update this policy', 'revised policy'
clauses.sample_language: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated via [email / in-app notification / website banner] before they take effect. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.
